# incitaciones

> A curated library of reusable prompts and skills for CLI LLM tools (Claude Code, Amp, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Windsurf, Zed). Install all skills with `npx skills add incitaciones` (skills.sh — works with any agent), `pi install npm:incitaciones` (pi), `npx incitaciones install` (all tools), or `./install.sh --global` (from a git clone). Per skill: `npx skills add incitaciones --skill <name>`.

## Getting Started

- [README](README.md): Quick start, install options, and meta-prompt for organizing your own prompts
- [Install Script](install.sh): Shell script to install skills
- [Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md): How to create, test, and submit new prompts

## Authorship

All code in this repository was generated by a large language model. Human contribution: requirements, curation, design decisions, and review.

Leer en español: https://charly-vibes.github.io/charly-vibes/
